commits.message:
fix(syntax): tokenize the whole code, bound every row to the width (rich-syntax-fh2)

Review of #256: a lineRange starting inside a multi-line string tokenized
as code; an unknown runtime language crashed at render; measure spread
every line into Math.max and reported min over max; justify realigned
each line; a gutter wider than the offer overflowed it; property names
like .get/.type drew as keywords.

fix(syntax): every option takes effect or is gone (rich-syntax-fh2)

- language picks a grammar (javascript, typescript, python, bash, text);
  SyntaxLanguage is the union, so a name with no grammar is a type error.
  One left-to-right scan, so a // in a string or a keyword in a comment
  is not highlighted.
- colours are syntax.* names in the console Theme; the ignored `theme`
  option is removed.
- wordWrap wraps (continuation rows unnumbered) or crops; before, wrapped
  pieces were joined back onto one overflowing line.
- lineRange keeps each line's number from the whole code.
- padding and Syntax.fromPath (always threw) are removed.
- empty lines are kept; measure reads the same shown lines as render.

fix(widgets): every widget cell takes its background from the theme (rich-widgets-73e) (#255)

* fix(widgets): every widget cell takes its background from the theme (rich-widgets-73e)

Checkbox, Slider and TextInput drew palette foregrounds over whatever the
terminal showed, so the dark default palette's white text vanished in a light
terminal. Every cell now takes both colours from the one palette through
src/widgets/ink.ts, which replaces six copies of resolvePalette and has no
foreground-only form. The slider's unfilled track moves from `surface` (1.1:1
on the palette's own background) to dimmed `foreground`.

test/widgets/terminal-contrast.test.ts renders each widget state without a
theme and requires 3:1 glyph contrast on two dark and two light terminals.

* fix(widgets): padding and disabled cells take the palette ground too (rich-widgets-73e)

Review pass (high): a multiline TextInput's padding and blank rows, and every
disabled state, still let the terminal's background through. The theme moves
onto ThemedWidget, whose ground pads every row; StaticItem keeps no ground.
Disabled cells draw in foreground-muted on background. Accent glyphs on the
background use text-primary. The contrast test now checks the ground under
every cell, disabled states included.

* fix(widgets): a TextInput pads its rows in the style its value is drawn in (rich-widgets-73e)

Review pass (medium): a caller's contentStyle background was striped by the
theme's ground in the padding of short multiline rows.
